summary: Docs-only change: BACKLOG.md is rewritten from a pinned investigation inventory into a short pre-release change record, AGENTS.md's route entry and the check-doc-refs exemption list are updated to match, and the script test is adjusted. The retained entries verify correctly against current sources (TaskGroupResult.failedTaskName()/members() combine gap at TaskGroupResult.java:132-172, TaskBatchResult.failedTaskResult() empty on pure timeout at TaskBatchResult.java:168-182, existing blob/dev/v0.5.0 links in docs/, unguarded ParRuntime registration warnings at ParRuntime.java:176,210 with the announce idiom available at ParRuntime.java:707), the doc-refs checker and its unit tests pass on the snapshot, and dropped items (purge members, deadline saturation, HTML lang check, TimeSource) are genuinely landed or recorded in design/decision-log.md. Two contract-drift issues remain: the mandatory refactoring-review workflow still routes deferred findings into the now-narrowed BACKLOG.md, and ADR 0010 still cites a backlog id (O-16) whose entry this rewrite deleted without distilling the open calibration risk anywhere.

findings.title: refactoring-review still routes deferred findings into the narrowed BACKLOG.md
findings.trigger: Any code change runs the mandatory /refactoring-review step (AGENTS.md requires it for every code change) and produces an out-of-diff or T2 finding that is not a breaking API change, release tooling, or a small pre-release fix; the agent follows principles.md:88 ('record its destination: BACKLOG.md, ...'), .agents/skills/refactoring-review/SKILL.md:71 ('out-of-diff 的发现查 BACKLOG.md 是否已登记') and SKILL.md:100 / refactoring-review/report-template.md:30 and records it into BACKLOG.md.
findings.consequence: BACKLOG.md's new contract ('Changes planned before a specific release... Open design questions live in design/decision-log.md and design/proposal/, not here', BACKLOG.md:3-6, mirrored in AGENTS.md:622-625) is contradicted by the refactoring-review documents this change left untouched, so deferred findings are either written into a file whose scope now excludes them or agents have no consistent destination for them.
findings.evidence: BACKLOG.md:1-6 narrows the file's scope and AGENTS.md:622-625 was updated in the same diff, but refactoring-review/principles.md:88 (T2 row), .agents/skills/refactoring-review/SKILL.md:71 and :100, and refactoring-review/report-template.md:30 still name BACKLOG.md as a destination for out-of-diff findings and T2 suggestions; design/AGENTS.md:63 and design/proposal-lifecycle.md:65 also keep BACKLOG as a harvest target.
findings.suggestedFix: Update the refactoring-review routing text (principles.md T2 row, SKILL.md steps 4 and 7, report-template.md deferred disposition, and the design/ harvest rules) to match the new backlog scope, e.g. 'BACKLOG.md only when the finding is planned before a specific release; otherwise a design/proposal/ entry or the report's open items'.

findings.title: ADR 0010 cites deleted BACKLOG O-16; the uncalibrated-threshold risk is now tracked nowhere
findings.trigger: A maintainer reads the 'costs and risks' section of adr/0010-always-on-workload-fit-screening.md and follows the 'BACKLOG O-16' pointer to check the open follow-up about uncalibrated workload-fit screening thresholds and WARNING noise.
findings.consequence: The entry no longer exists: this rewrite removed O-16 from BACKLOG.md (the new file keeps only 'was A-P3/O-13/O-15/O-18' ids for traceability), and no decision-log entry or proposal records the calibration follow-up, so the ADR citation dangles and the accepted risk loses its only tracking location — contrary to the AGENTS.md rule that deleted material's conclusions be distilled into an owning document before removal.
findings.evidence: adr/0010-always-on-workload-fit-screening.md:67 lists '常开的 WARNING ... 周期长度与阈值未经真实负载校准（BACKLOG O-16）' as a live risk (line 24 also cites the resolved O-17); the new BACKLOG.md contains no O-16 entry, and grep of design/decision-log.md and design/proposal/ finds no distilled record of the threshold-calibration follow-up.
findings.suggestedFix: Either keep a one-line O-16 entry in BACKLOG.md (it is a genuine pre-1.0.0 calibration candidate) or distill the accepted risk into design/decision-log.md under the ADR 0010 entry and adjust the ADR citation so it no longer points at a removed backlog id.
